capture_chunk_limit_failure_before_fix.observed: An AVAudioEngine tap exceeded the original single-block 4096-frame limit and mapped to UnsupportedDimensions (reason 2).
capture_chunk_limit_failure_before_fix.repair: Fixed-size slicing into up to 16 preallocated 4096-frame blocks, plus callback/queue overflow fail-closed behavior.

accelerated_fixture_and_microphone.microphone_permission: macOS authorization status reached Granted after user-initiated Start.
accelerated_fixture_and_microphone.real_microphone_inference: VERIFIED: two physical microphone sessions; one captured 47.8 s without nonempty recognition, and one produced nonempty partial and final text. This demonstrates path feasibility only; no human-reviewed reference or WER exists.

successful_spoken_session.input_encoding: NOT_RECORDED; the app displayed sample rate/channel count but did not serialize the ASBD encoding.
successful_spoken_session.metrics_save_failure: The explicit exclusive metrics path had already been used by the preceding no-speech session; no overwrite was attempted.
successful_spoken_session.queue_overflow_count: No overflow reported; session reached Result ready.

limitations: The app-window runs used timed fixture PCM, not a physical microphone.
The app profile spans two consecutive fixture sessions; there was no child/helper process in sampled snapshots.
The app process high-water and RSS sampler are development evidence on an 18 GB host, not 4 GB certification.
The second app session used the same exclusive metrics filename and correctly refused to overwrite it; its rendered result was observed in the UI.
The app run was ad hoc signed for local development and is not a distribution build.

metrics_detail.metrics_save_failure: Exclusive metrics path already existed from the first session; result and rounded metrics were visible in the window.

native_runtime.source_note: The build tree was an external source snapshot without .git metadata; the explicit expected revision, C API header constants, and exact verified native dylib identities were checked.
